declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy certificate →
    policy.quorumWeight ≤
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.realizedVotingWeight policy certificate.signers
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.accepted_certificate_realizes_weight_threshold

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy certificate →
    policy.minimumFailureDomains ≤ certificate.failureDomains.length
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.accepted_certificate_realizes_failure_domain_threshold

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.realizedVotingWeight policy certificate.signers <
      policy.quorumWeight →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.insufficient_voting_weight_rejects_certificate

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme),
  certificate.failureDomains.length < policy.minimumFailureDomains →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.insufficient_failure_domain_coverage_rejects_certificate

declarations.type:
∀ (scheme : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.CanonicalMembershipScheme)
  (policy : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.MembershipPolicy)
  (certificate : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.QuorumCertificate scheme)
  (signer : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinCanonicalMembership.NodeId),
  signer ∈ certificate.signers →
    (¬∃ member, member ∈ policy.members ∧ member.nodeId = signer) →
      ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.AcceptsQuorumCertificate scheme policy certificate
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinQuorumRealization.unknown_signer_rejects_certificate
